title: Frozen by My Fiance, Adored by the Dragon King

source_and_render_qa.content_caveat: Fantasy romance/revenge; betrayal, left-to-die-in-snow peril, a stabbing with blood, fantasy dragon violence. One near-kiss (ep9). No sexual content found in full two-pass review (OCR transcripts + visual frame grids) of all 9 episodes. Free run of 9 episodes.

instagram_resume.scope: Instagram only. Private YouTube copyright checks waived for this series start at owner direction; copyright risk remains untested. YouTube publishing and DMs remain held. Not rights clearance.
